node.label: leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, 6
node.definition: A leukodystrophy characterized by slowly progressive spasticity, extrapyramidal movement disorders (dystonia, choreoathetosis and rigidity), cerebellar ataxia, moderate to severe cognitive deficit, and anarthria/dysarthria.
synonyms: hypomyelination with atrophy of basal ganglia and cerebellum
